description: Find printer profiles, check bed fit, slice to .gcode.3mf and extract the G-code.
name: io.github.richardofortune/cadloop-slicer

environmentVariables.description: The only directory this server reads and writes. Defaults to ~/cad.
environmentVariables.name: SLICER_WORKSPACE

environmentVariables.description: Path to the slicer binary. Auto-detected if unset. Creality Print's CLI does not work headless on macOS; prefer OrcaSlicer, Bambu Studio or ElegooSlicer there.
environmentVariables.name: SLICER_BIN

environmentVariables.description: Extra profile roots, os.pathsep separated. Added to the auto-detected roots rather than replacing them.
environmentVariables.name: SLICER_PROFILE_DIRS

environmentVariables.description: Seconds before a slice is killed. Defaults to 600.
environmentVariables.name: SLICER_TIMEOUT

title: cadloop Slicer
